Optional '''language''' — ISO language code for this printing, for example <code>ja</code>. Shows the printed-language row and enables optional edition metadata. Omit for existing English entries. '''language_display''' supplies a sourced display value instead of the language name; '''label_language''' preserves an existing row label.

'''printed_title''', '''printed_game_text''' and '''printed_lore''' hold the printing's native text, including its punctuation and title markers. They render in their own language-tagged sections. '''translation''' holds the English translation separately; '''translation_note''' holds a comparison with the English printing. Never substitute English card text for an unreadable Japanese face. Preserve a distinction between a blank printed field and a field that has not been transcribed.

Optional '''edition''', '''border_finish''', '''release''', '''size''' and '''year''' show metadata rows when supplied together with '''language'''. Set identifies the product; '''set_icon''' identifies the symbol actually printed on this face. A foil or introductory product can reuse another expansion's symbol or print the premium symbol. Read the face rather than inferring its symbol from the product name.

The migration also supports existing article material through '''lead''', '''navigation''', '''image_note''', '''type_display''', '''set_display''', '''rarity_display''', '''extra_info''', '''extra_sections''' and '''see_also_heading'''. Display overrides preserve existing linked wording without changing the underlying side/type/set values. '''extra_info''' accepts table rows inside the shared infobox; it must not contain another infobox table. The '''label_type''', '''label_gemp_id''', '''label_dark_icons''', '''label_light_icons''', '''label_icons''', '''label_landspeed''' and '''label_versions''' overrides retain existing field labels. '''category_override''' retains an exceptional printing's complete existing category list; omit it for ordinary new entries.

Example of separate native and translated fields (an abridged language-field example; add the verified image, statistics, Versions and sources for a complete article):
<pre>
{{Card
|title=Alderaan
|side=Light
|type=Location
|subtype=System
|set=Premiere (Japanese)
|language=ja
|set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]])
|printed_title=オルデラン
|translation='''Title:''' Alderaan.
}}
</pre>
